description: The arrival of the Defiant and the search for the Dominion's Founders bring the Gamma Quadrant threat closer, while Odo learns the truth of his people and the Alpha Quadrant begins preparing for infiltration.

s03e01.description: Sisko takes the new Defiant into the Gamma Quadrant seeking the Dominion's Founders, while Odo feels an unexplained pull toward home.

s03e02.description: Odo meets his own people as Sisko appears to face a Federation compromise with the Dominion whose reality is more complicated than it seems.

s03e03.description: A boast about killing a Klingon drags Quark into a family succession dispute and an unwilling marriage on Qo'noS.

s03e04.description: Jadzia's hallucinations lead to a suppressed chapter in the Dax symbiont's history and a secret the Trill authorities buried.

s03e05.description: Kira is abducted, altered to look Cardassian and told that her Bajoran identity is merely the cover of a long-term intelligence operative.

s03e06.description: Odo tries to raise a rapidly maturing Jem'Hadar child without the violent conditioning imposed by the Dominion.

s03e07.description: A forgotten Cardassian security program mistakes the crew for rebelling Bajoran workers and turns the station into an escalating death trap.

s03e08.description: Dax falls for a man on a planet that periodically shifts out of normal space while Quark pursues an intrusive holosuite commission.

s03e09.description: A man claiming to be Will Riker steals the Defiant with Kira aboard, revealing a Maquis mission deep inside Cardassian territory.

s03e10.description: The Bajoran Gratitude Festival becomes chaotic when Lwaxana's condition causes station residents to develop wildly misplaced romantic obsessions.

s03e11.description: A transporter accident strands Sisko, Bashir and Dax in 2024 San Francisco just before a pivotal uprising that history requires.

s03e12.description: Sisko assumes the identity of a dead historical figure while the crew struggles to restore the events that lead to Earth's social reforms.

s03e13.description: Bashir keeps Bareil alive through increasingly extreme procedures so Bajor's peace negotiations with Cardassia can continue.

s03e14.description: Kira becomes trapped in an expanding crystal formation while Nog surprises Sisko by asking for help entering Starfleet Academy.

s03e15.description: A joint Bajoran-Cardassian science project appears to fulfill an ancient prophecy about the wormhole, dividing faith and scientific interpretation.

s03e16.description: Quark is horrified when Grand Nagus Zek rewrites the Rules of Acquisition around generosity and sets out to discover what changed him.

s03e17.description: Radiation exposure causes O'Brien to jump hours into the future, letting him glimpse disasters the station has not yet suffered.

s03e18.description: After an attack leaves Bashir unconscious, he experiences an aging DS9 shaped by fragments of his own mind.

s03e19.description: Mirror-universe O'Brien kidnaps Sisko to impersonate his dead counterpart and sway the alternate Jennifer Sisko toward the rebellion.

s03e20.description: A bomb destroys Garak's shop, drawing Odo into a trail that leads toward a secret Cardassian-Romulan operation against the Dominion.

s03e21.description: Garak is forced to interrogate Odo as a Cardassian-Romulan fleet enters the Gamma Quadrant to destroy the Founders.

s03e22.description: Sisko builds an ancient Bajoran lightship to prove early explorers could have reached Cardassia without warp drive.

s03e23.description: Quark and Rom return to Ferenginar after their mother violates Ferengi law by wearing clothes and earning profit.

s03e24.description: Kira's attempt to recover farming equipment from her former resistance leader escalates into a political confrontation with Kai Winn.

s03e25.description: Jadzia's zhian'tara gives friends the personalities of previous Dax hosts while Nog completes a crucial Starfleet Academy test.

s03e26.description: A newly promoted Sisko takes Defiant on patrol and discovers a Changeling saboteur hidden among the crew.
